ConfigSaveIn.title: ConfigSaveIn
ConfigSaveIn.description:
A session's round to save as a config (`/api/configs`): the session (its handle or ID), the run (default: the
one it finished on, else its last finished one), the name.

CopyIn.title: CopyIn
CopyIn.description:
Where a new session's query comes from: a session's run (its handle; the run it finished on, else its last), or
a saved config by id or name (`library`: the same, as it was called before configs replaced the library).

Envelope.title: Envelope
Envelope.description: A tool's answer: its JSON, its pictures, what the card shows, the prose that follows it.

ExampleKey.title: ExampleKey
ExampleKey.description:
Which cached proposal an example was copied from (PLAN.md section 14.3).

The examples made from one detected object's outline share its box and are
told apart by `part` (PLAN.md 16.6); other keys have none.

ExamplesIn.title: ExamplesIn
ExamplesIn.description:
OWL: cached proposals by id. Local models: boxes, polygons, points or detected
objects' outlines, encoded on their server.

FewshotIn.title: FewshotIn
FewshotIn.description:
A Fewshot query's settings (PLAN.md 29.7), each the server's default when absent: the click's brush radius in
cells, the share of channels Fisher selection drops, and the size limits of a part in cells (min_size None:
the brush's area, the plugin's "= marker"; max_size 0: none); `refine`: the parts' outlines redrawn by SAM3's
tracker (E10, the plugin's "Refine with SAM"), off by default as there.

FileIn.title: FileIn
FileIn.description: A file the user attached in ChatGPT, as ChatGPT passes it (`openai/fileParams`): a download URL that expires.

file.description: A file the user attached to the chat (ChatGPT passes it)

MarkIn.title: MarkIn
MarkIn.description:
A correction the user clicked on the widget (T3): a detection that is wrong (`det`), or a place where an object
was missed (`x`, `y` in image pixels), on the run they looked at.

OutlineEditIn.title: OutlineEditIn
OutlineEditIn.description:
An outline someone edited and saved (PLAN.md 23.6): the prompt and window it was made with, all the masks
the last call gave, and the chosen one.

OutlineExampleIn.title: OutlineExampleIn
OutlineExampleIn.description: A detected object for +/-: its outline (a detection's `polygon_px`) and its box.

OutlinesIn.title: OutlinesIn
OutlinesIn.description: A box detector's results as a page shows them (PLAN.md 23.5): their boxes as /api/detect gave them.

PixelRef.title: PixelRef
PixelRef.description:
An example's features for pixel classifiers (PLAN.md 27.6): their id in the feature store, how many cells,
and the feature space they belong to.

SatelliteIn.title: SatelliteIn
SatelliteIn.description: An area drawn on the gallery's map, in degrees, the zoom to fetch it at, and the image's name.

ScaleIn.title: ScaleIn
ScaleIn.description: The image a published config runs over at scale (`/api/configs/{id}/scale`).

SessionIn.title: SessionIn
SessionIn.description: A session to check or make: one of the user's mosaics and an AOI (GeoJSON in WGS 84, or [w, s, e, n]).

file.title: File
file.description: A file the user attached to the chat (ChatGPT passes it)

WindowIn.title: WindowIn
WindowIn.description: A window of the image in image pixels, as /api/select answered it.

mapflow_interactive__app__SelectIn.title: SelectIn
mapflow_interactive__app__SelectIn.description: Clicks and a box of one selection (PLAN.md 17.5), and the window of the previous answer.

mapflow_interactive__app__ViewIn.title: ViewIn
mapflow_interactive__app__ViewIn.description: A map view in image pixels.
